title: Micro RNA differential expression profile in canine mammary gland tumor by next generation sequencing.
authors: Chen, Hui-Wen; Lai, Yu-Chang; Rahman, Md Mahfuzur; Husna, Al Asmaul; Hasan, Md Nazmul; Miura, Naoki
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过NGS和qPCR鉴定犬乳腺肿瘤中差异表达miRNA并预测其靶基因，属于纯表达谱与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Canine mammary gland tumors are very common and represent a potential model of human breast cancer, and microRNA (miRNAs) are promising biomarkers and therapeutic targets for these tumors. Accordingly, we aimed to identify miRNAs differentially expressed in canine mammary gland tumors using next generation sequencing (NGS), with subsequent confirmatory qPCR and target gene analyses. Mammary gland tissue was collected from healthy dogs (n=7) and dogs with suspected tumors (n=80). A subset of samples was analyzed with NGS to identify differentially expressed miRNAs with CLC Genome Workbench. Normal (n=10), tumor-adjacent (n=6), and tumor-bearing (n=76) mammary gland tissue samples were analyzed for the identified miRNAs using qPCR. An in silico analysis (TargetScan) was performed to predict the miRNAs' target genes using gene ontology (GO) terms and the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) database (DAVID). We identified four miRNAs (cfa-miR-1-3p, cfa-miR-133a-3p, cfa-miR-133b-3p, and cfa-miR-133c-3p) as down regulated in canine mammary gland tumor tissues relative to normal and tumor adjacent tissues. KEGG analysis revealed the potential target genes of cfa-miR-1-3p are related to the Rap1 signaling pathway, adherens junction, and Ras signaling pathway, and those of the miR-133 family are related to the TGF-beta signaling pathway, synaptic vesicle cycle, and sphingolipid signaling pathway. In combination, these target genes are related to the regulation of transcription and DNA binding transcription (GO analysis), and the Hippo signaling pathway, adherens junction, and endocytosis (KEGG analysis). Accordingly, we suggest these four miRNAs are promising potential biomarker candidates for canine mammary gland tumors warranting further investigation.
abstract_zh: 犬乳腺肿瘤非常常见，并可作为人类乳腺癌的潜在模型，而microRNA（miRNAs）是这些肿瘤的有前景的生物标志物和治疗靶点。因此，我们旨在利用下一代测序（NGS）鉴定犬乳腺肿瘤中差异表达的miRNAs，随后进行验证性qPCR和靶基因分析。从健康犬（n=7）和疑似肿瘤犬（n=80）中收集乳腺组织。使用CLC Genome Workbench对部分样本进行NGS分析，以鉴定差异表达的miRNAs。对正常（n=10）、肿瘤邻近（n=6）和肿瘤携带（n=76）乳腺组织样本进行qPCR分析，以检测所鉴定的miRNAs。通过计算机模拟分析（TargetScan）预测miRNAs的靶基因，并使用基因本体论（GO）术语和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）数据库（DAVID）进行分析。我们鉴定出四个miRNAs（cfa-miR-1-3p、cfa-miR-133a-3p、cfa-miR-133b-3p和cfa-miR-133c-3p）在犬乳腺肿瘤组织中相对于正常和肿瘤邻近组织下调。KEGG分析显示，cfa-miR-1-3p的潜在靶基因与Rap1信号通路、黏附连接和Ras信号通路相关，而miR-133家族的靶基因与TGF-β信号通路、突触囊泡循环和鞘脂信号通路相关。综合来看，这些靶基因与转录调控和DNA结合转录（GO分析）以及Hippo信号通路、黏附连接和内吞作用（KEGG分析）相关。因此，我们建议这四个miRNAs是犬乳腺肿瘤的有前景的潜在生物标志物候选，值得进一步研究。
